items.title: Expose managed asset root diagnostics in lattice check results
items.context: runManagedAssetCheck currently returns profile/assetMode/items/manifestPath only. Add stable JSON fields that identify the metadata/asset root, resolved gitRoot when available, and whether managed asset paths are relative to metadata root. Do not move asset writes to gitRoot; this is diagnostic clarity and evidence shape only.
items.userSees: lattice check --json includes explicit metadataRoot/assetRoot/gitRoot path-base diagnostics.

happy.desc: Run lattice check --json in a normal project and parse the root JSON object; assert explicit root diagnostics are present as stable machine-readable fields for metadataRoot, assetRoot, gitRoot, and the asset-path relativity flag/context rather than only being inferable from manifestPath or item relPath strings.

Verify the JSON root diagnostics identify metadataRoot/assetRoot as the base for managed asset relPath/applied paths while preserving the existing profile, assetMode, manifestPath, summary, and items fields for backward-compatible consumers.

edge.desc: Run lattice check --json where metadataRoot and configured gitRoot differ; assert metadataRoot and assetRoot resolve to the wrapper metadata root while gitRoot resolves to the configured repo root, with all fields explicit even when paths differ.

Run lattice check --json where gitRoot is absent or unavailable; assert the gitRoot diagnostic is still explicit as null/empty by contract and metadataRoot/assetRoot remain populated so callers never have to guess the path base.

adversarial.desc: Fail the item if the implementation only adds prose or nested per-item hints but no explicit root-level JSON diagnostics, because JSON consumers must not scrape text or reverse-engineer roots from relative paths.

Fail the item if adding gitRoot diagnostics changes relPath/applied path semantics or makes managed asset paths appear gitRoot-relative; diagnostics may explain gitRoot but must not redefine the asset root.

items.title: Render clear path-base guidance in lattice check text output
items.context: renderManagedAssetCheck should show where relPath/applied/manifest paths are rooted, especially when metadataRoot != gitRoot. The text should make ClawCreek-style wrapper roots obvious before recommending check --apply.
items.userSees: lattice check text output explains that managed asset relPath values are relative to the metadata/asset root, and displays gitRoot when different.

items.title: Add wrapper-root regression coverage for lattice check diagnostics
items.context: Add a focused smoke/test that builds a non-git metadata root with configured gitRoot subdir and verifies check JSON/text identify assetRoot/metadataRoot separately from gitRoot while keeping relPath semantics unchanged.
items.userSees: A regression command proves wrapper-root lattice check diagnostics are explicit and apply semantics remain metadata-root based.
